tagline: One quiet core for every device
brief: A tray-first Windows app that replaces vendor suites for monitoring, displays, RGB, fans and the AIO LCD. It runs near zero RAM and only shows a window when asked.
criteria: Success: reads at 16 px in the tray on light and dark taskbars, works in one colour, and does not look like a gaming-brand mark.

concepts.name: Crate
concepts.idea: A crate as an isometric cube: the machine's devices in one box, with the lid lit.
rationale: Three faces and one lit lid: one owner, many devices
Survives one colour: the gaps keep the cube readable in black or white
Ink tile app icon stays visible on light and dark taskbars
Emerald is the only colour, as in DESIGN.md

recommendation: Crate: the cube carries the vendor-suite 'crate' lineage without copying a shape, and the lit lid gives one recognisable colour event.
next_steps: Use the horizontal lockup in the README
Make a new icon.icns if a macOS build is ever planned
Run a trademark search before public release
